title: mentha linnaei var. germanica
intro: Mentha linnaei var. germanica, commonly known as German Bergamot Mint, is a subspecies of the mint plant, characterized by its unique combination of minty and citrusy aromas. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, relieve stress and anxiety, and provide relief from nausea and headaches. The therapeutic actions of German Bergamot Mint include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthone, limonene, and linalool, which contribute to its medicinal properties and fragrance.
